details: Bitcoin's volatility has dropped to a nine-month low, with the Bitcoin Volmex Implied Volatility Index reaching 36.11 on Monday, May 26, indicating a period of market consolidation. Concurrently, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced approximately $1 billion in net outflows in May, reversing a two-month trend of inflows and suggesting cooling investor demand.
title: Bitcoin Volatility Hits 9-Month Low Amid ETF Outflows

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has postponed its anticipated "innovation exemption" framework, which would have permitted domestic crypto firms to trade tokenized versions of stocks. The delay is intended to allow for further feedback from stock exchange executives and market participants.
title: SEC Delays Tokenized Stock Trading Exemption for Crypto Firms

details: Nasdaq has secured conditional approval from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to list cash-settled Bitcoin index options. These European-style derivatives, under the ticker QBTC, will track the CME CF Bitcoin Real Time Index and settle entirely in U.S. dollars.
title: Nasdaq Receives Conditional SEC Approval for Bitcoin Options

details: A significant $1.29 billion dark pool block trade involving BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) was executed on Nasdaq. Despite the large transaction, Bitcoin's price remained stable above $75,000, and IBIT closed in positive territory, reflecting strong liquidity within the ETF.
title: BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin ETF Records $1.29 Billion Dark Pool Trade

details: The Ethereum Foundation is facing a series of high-profile departures, sparking discussions within the community about a "brain drain" and the organization's future. Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has reportedly suggested the Foundation should scale down and delegate asset promotion to external groups.
title: Ethereum Foundation Experiences High-Profile Departures
